outcome: Need for supplementation with infant formula
cohort: 329 exclusively breastfed infants with EWL/HD and gestational age of at least 37 weeks, born at a Baby-Friendly certified Hospital in Portugal between 2013 and 2015.
finding: EWL/HD were common among the studied population, particularly in infants born to primiparous mothers and by cesarean delivery, but complications were rare and treatment was mainly noninvasive.
mod_finding: The average weight loss was higher in infants born by cesarean delivery (11.1%) compared to vaginal delivery (10.6%).
